# lakekeeper_namespace (Data Source)

Read an existing namespace by its project, warehouse UUID and dotted path. Verifies the warehouse belongs to the project. Requires OpenFGA to read managed access. No resources or permissions are changed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lakekeeper_namespace" "gold" {
  project_id   = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
  warehouse_id = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
  name         = "operational.lims.inventory.gold"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Dotted namespace path, including all parent levels.
- `project_id` (String) Expected project UUID.
- `warehouse_id` (String) Exact warehouse UUID; names are not used to select warehouses.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite project/warehouse/namespace UUID identity.
- `managed_access` (Boolean) Whether managed access is enabled directly on this namespace.
- `namespace_id` (String) Namespace UUID for permission assignments.
